title: 三国鼎立
subtitle: Three Kingdoms — Rise of Rival States

cards.example: 东汉末年，军阀混战。
cards.exampleTranslation: At the end of the Eastern Han, warlords fought in chaos.
cards.breakdown: 军：车（车）上盖着布（冖），军队的战车 · 阀：门（门）里有武力（伐），手握兵权的人

cards.example: 曹操是个杰出的政治家。
cards.exampleTranslation: Cao Cao was an outstanding statesman.
cards.breakdown: 杰：木上站着一个了不起的人 · 出：脚从山里走出来，超出众人

cards.example: 曹操能谋善断。
cards.exampleTranslation: Cao Cao was skilled in strategy and decisive.

cards.example: 曹操三次发布求贤令。
cards.exampleTranslation: Cao Cao issued the edict seeking talent three times.
cards.breakdown: 求：伸出手恳求 · 贤：贝（贝）表示才华像宝贝一样珍贵 · 令：人在高台上发号施令

cards.example: 不论门第高低，有能力就可以做官。
cards.exampleTranslation: Regardless of family status, anyone with ability could become an official.
cards.breakdown: 门：一扇大门，代表一个家族 · 第：竹简上排列的次序

cards.example: 曹操推行屯田制发展农业。
cards.exampleTranslation: Cao Cao promoted the military farming system to develop agriculture.
cards.breakdown: 屯：草木刚刚冒出地面 · 田：划分好的田地 · 制：用刀（刂）裁制规则

cards.example: 魏、蜀、吴三国鼎立形成。
cards.exampleTranslation: The three kingdoms of Wei, Shu, and Wu stood in a three-way rivalry.
cards.breakdown: 鼎：古代三脚铜器，象征三方力量并立 · 立：一个人站在地上

cards.example: 东汉末年，军阀混战。
cards.exampleTranslation: At the end of the Eastern Han, warlords fought in chaos.
cards.breakdown: 混：水（氵）混在一起，分不清 · 战：拿着戈（戈）去打仗

cards.back: Red Cliff (site of the famous battle in 208 CE)
cards.example: 刘备和孙权联军决战于赤壁。
cards.exampleTranslation: Liu Bei and Sun Quan's allied forces fought the decisive battle at Red Cliff.
cards.breakdown: 赤：大火（大+火）烧得通红 · 壁：墙壁上的土（土）

cards.example: 孙刘联军可以打败曹军。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Sun-Liu allied forces could defeat Cao's army.
cards.breakdown: 联：耳（耳）朵相连，联合在一起 · 军：军队

cards.example: 曹操率大军20万南下。
cards.exampleTranslation: Cao Cao led a 200,000-strong army southward.

cards.example: 刘备有2万兵马。
cards.exampleTranslation: Liu Bei had 20,000 troops.

cards.example: 北方士兵晕船又不会游泳。
cards.exampleTranslation: The northern soldiers got seasick and couldn't swim.
cards.breakdown: 晕：太阳（日）周围一圈光晕，头晕目眩 · 船：在水上行走的舟（舟）

cards.example: 曹操采用了连环船的办法。
cards.exampleTranslation: Cao Cao adopted the method of chain-linked boats.
cards.breakdown: 连：车（车）一辆接一辆 · 环：玉（王）做成圆圈，一环扣一环

cards.example: 将战船用铁链连在一起。
cards.exampleTranslation: The warships were linked together with iron chains.
cards.breakdown: 铁：金属（钅）中最硬的 · 链：金属（钅）做成的一环一环的链条

cards.example: 黄盖假装投降曹操。
cards.exampleTranslation: Huang Gai pretended to surrender to Cao Cao.
cards.breakdown: 投：用手（扌）把东西扔出去 · 降：从高处（阝）走下来，低头服从

cards.example: 黄盖带领十只小船向曹营划来。
cards.exampleTranslation: Huang Gai led ten small boats rowing toward Cao's camp.

cards.example: 黄盖带领十艘小船。
cards.exampleTranslation: Huang Gai led ten small boats.

cards.back: thrown into chaos / in complete disarray
cards.example: 曹军乱作一团。
cards.exampleTranslation: Cao's army was thrown into complete chaos.

cards.example: 曹军大败。
cards.exampleTranslation: Cao's army suffered a crushing defeat.
cards.breakdown: 败：用手（攵）把贝壳（贝）打碎，失败了

cards.example: 曹丕废汉献帝自立为帝。
cards.exampleTranslation: Cao Pi deposed Emperor Xian of Han and declared himself emperor.
cards.breakdown: 废：广大的房屋（广）里用手（殳）丢弃，废除

cards.back: dynastic title / official name of a state
cards.example: 曹丕国号魏。
cards.exampleTranslation: Cao Pi named his state Wei.

cards.example: 刘备在成都称帝。
cards.exampleTranslation: Liu Bei proclaimed himself emperor in Chengdu.

cards.example: 西晋定都洛阳。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Western Jin established its capital in Luoyang.

cards.example: 魏国最强，灭了蜀。
cards.exampleTranslation: Wei was the strongest and conquered Shu.
cards.breakdown: 灭：一横压在火上面，把火压灭了

cards.back: to unify the north and south
cards.example: 西晋派兵灭吴，统一南北。
cards.exampleTranslation: The Western Jin sent troops to conquer Wu, unifying north and south.

cards.back: Cao Cao — warlord who unified northern China; outstanding statesman, strategist, and poet
cards.example: 曹操实力最强，基本统一了北方。
cards.exampleTranslation: Cao Cao was the most powerful and basically unified the north.

cards.back: Liu Bei — founded the Kingdom of Shu Han in Chengdu
cards.example: 刘备在成都称帝，国号汉。
cards.exampleTranslation: Liu Bei proclaimed himself emperor in Chengdu, naming his state Han.

cards.back: Sun Quan — founded the Kingdom of Wu in Jianye (Nanjing)
cards.example: 孙权在建业称帝，国号吴。
cards.exampleTranslation: Sun Quan proclaimed himself emperor in Jianye, naming his state Wu.

cards.back: Zhuge Liang — brilliant strategist; advisor to Liu Bei
cards.example: 诸葛亮认为孙刘联军可以打败曹军。
cards.exampleTranslation: Zhuge Liang believed the Sun-Liu allied forces could defeat Cao's army.

cards.back: Zhou Yu — Sun Quan's chief general at Red Cliff
cards.example: 孙权的大将周瑜派黄盖假装投降曹操。
cards.exampleTranslation: Sun Quan's general Zhou Yu sent Huang Gai to pretend to surrender to Cao Cao.

cards.back: Huang Gai — Wu general who led the fire-attack at Red Cliff
cards.example: 黄盖带领十只小船向曹营划来。
cards.exampleTranslation: Huang Gai led ten small boats rowing toward Cao's camp.

cards.back: Cao Pi — Cao Cao's son; founded the Kingdom of Wei
cards.example: 曹丕废汉献帝自立为帝，国号魏。
cards.exampleTranslation: Cao Pi deposed Emperor Xian and declared himself emperor, naming his state Wei.

cards.back: Sima Yan — founded the Western Jin dynasty in 265 CE
cards.example: 265年，司马炎废魏帝建立晋朝。
cards.exampleTranslation: In 265, Sima Yan deposed the Wei emperor and established the Jin dynasty.
